annotations.title: Read the company text from a file

description: When the site cannot be read: a saved page (HTML), a PDF or a text file -> its text, to describe the company with suggest_company_description(text=...). Part of a new search's onboarding: the first assistant call of an onboarding spends one brief (a free account has one search brief and may call each assistant once); pass the returned onboarding_id to the next calls and to create_search. [REST: POST /api/assist/site_file]

file_name.description: The file's name with its extension.

onboarding_id.description: The onboarding id that ties the assistant calls and create_search into ONE brief. Omit it on the first call: the answer gives one; pass it to every later assistant call and to create_search of the same new search.

name: extract_site_file_text
